name: A · The terminal (pick)
desc: A 1983 analyst's desk: the chart in real pixels on the CRT (crisp pixel art, thresholded glyphs), scanlines and the lamp's reflection over it. Switch = the painted F-keys (F1 hit rate, F2 P&L, F5-F7 window), mirrored in the screen's menu bar.

name: B · Agent Tower
desc: The evaluation floor at the top of a tower: four sealed pods, one monitor each in the board's order, each a vector display of its AI's figure and line against the coin flip, on one shared scale. Switch = the console's two knobs (mode, window); the index mark turns.

name: C · The polygraph
desc: A lie-detector test for four AIs: the pens have written each hit rate up the strip chart, newest round at the pens; the coin flip is the red centre rule. Switch = the examiner's typed tick boxes at the near end of the strip, ticked in red pencil.

name: D · The printout
desc: A 1970s computer room: the line printer types a classic printer plot on green-bar paper, one line per round, letters G C P K at each hit rate, the coin flip a red ribbon column. Switch = the job header's bracketed options; the printer types the new run.
